The reference designators differ from the spec (e.g. U5->U10, U4->U11, Q2->Q3, Q1->Q2, R2->R1, R1->R2, J1->J5, J7->J2, J4->J6, J5->J8, J3->J10, IC1->IC2, L2->L1, L1->L3) but this is a consistent relabeling of a different build, not a behavioral deviation. The localized connections I can trace (HW_RESET switch to GND, debug UART TX/RX to the 3-pin header, SD VDD to +3V3, boost gate to the FPC GDR pin, sense resistor from MOSFET source to GND, regulator EN tied to VIN and MODE to GND, RJ45 now bridged to the module's LAN_PORT nets) are all consistent with the spec, and the spec's documented known issues (barrel-jack battery-disconnect behavior, the earlier display-MOSFET heating bug, the inferred bit-banged SPI) are explicitly not anomalies. The long cross-sheet bus traces are not legible at the supplied resolution, and no deviation in them is supported by the drawing, so I report no anomaly.
